   - Determine the difference in Cash and cash equivalents between 2019 and 2018.
   - Calculate the percentage change based on the difference.

   - **Difference Calculation:** 
     \[
     \text{Difference} = \text{Cash and cash equivalents in 2019} - \text{Cash and cash equivalents in 2018}
     \]
     \[
     \text{Difference} = 15.4 - 20.3 = -4.9 \text{ million}

   - **Percentage Change Calculation:**

     \[
     \text{Percentage Change} = \left(\frac{\text{Difference}}{\text{Cash and cash equivalents in 2018}}\right) \times 100

# Output the result

# Done
